comparator_policy: The active production model is the paired incumbent on every identical eligible match.
difference_convention: candidate minus production; negative means lower error

eligibility.training_rule: all eligible data strictly before each validation year
eligibility.same_day_rule: all predictions for a date precede every update from that date
eligibility.exposed_2025_2026_period: retrospective diagnostics only; never pristine confirmation evidence

bootstrap.rationale: Date blocks retain same-day dependence while paired resampling preserves match equality.

threshold_rationale.mae: Two to three hundredths of a goal per match is a conservative non-inferiority allowance relative to roughly one-goal side MAE and 1.3-goal total/margin MAE.
threshold_rationale.relative_bias: Five hundredths per scoring side and 0.075 total are small relative to natural match-level goal variance and materially tighter than catastrophic failure, but do not demand that a candidate outperform an incumbent-specific zero-bias target.
threshold_rationale.bias_bootstrap: The wider 0.08 side and 0.10 total upper bounds account for instability of a signed mean while still excluding operationally meaningful deterioration.
threshold_rationale.fold_bias: A 0.10-goal absolute-bias regression in multiple folds indicates repeatable temporal harm; one fold may vary because scoring environments shift.
threshold_rationale.catastrophic_limits: Absolute 0.35 side or 0.50 total bias would be plainly broken at match scale regardless of incumbent quality.
threshold_rationale.independence: Values were fixed from domain scale, incumbent behavior, prior v1 materiality conventions, and fold variability—not from the exact amount required by a candidate.

decision_rule: Every mandatory condition must pass. Gate v2 remains immutable after evaluation; defects require a separately versioned proposal.
